title: INFERRING OFFENSIVENESS IN IMAGES FROM NATURAL LANGUAGE SUPERVISION
findings: The paper's method for detecting offensive images was able to identify content with religious dimensions. Specific examples flagged as potentially offensive included images of a burning church, persons in Ku-Klux-Klan uniforms (a group which co-opts Christian symbolism), and a harmed woman wearing an abaya (a garment associated with some Muslim women). This indicates the model can detect potentially offensive scenarios that involve religious symbols, places, or attire as part of a broader offensiveness detection task.
